topic: API version rollback and data check
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on technical maintenance regarding an API endpoint. It was determined that the code needed to be rolled back from version 3 (v3) to version 2 (v2). This change was necessary because the new URL was returning outdated data. Someone confirmed that no requests for v3 were made on the day of the check.
decisions: The API endpoint code must be rolled back from v3 to v2.
action_items: Someone (me) implemented the rollback and checked for v3 requests.
